column1: # Confidence = WHO 2023 grading group: 1=Associated with resistance,
#   4=Not associated with resistance - interim, 5=Not associated with resistance
# Source: WHO. Catalogue of mutations in Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex and
#   their association with drug resistance, 2nd ed. Geneva: WHO; 2023.
#   Result: 103 mutations (23 in group 1, 80 in group 2).
#   WHO-graded in-frame indels are not single-codon substitutions and are
#   not listed; amr_scan reports every RRDR indel separately.
# Notes in the source column: borderline = WHO 'borderline' mutation;
#   RRDR rule = graded by WHO's RRDR additional grading criterion.
# IMPORTANT: This uses M. tuberculosis numbering, NOT E. coli numbering.
# E. coli S531 = M. tuberculosis S450, H526 = H445, D516 = D435, etc.
# Ref AAs verified against H37Rv protein NP_215181.1 (1172 aa)
